Elon Musk Promotes Controversial Film 'Citizen Vigilante' on Social Media

Actor Armie Hammer's action thriller film 'Citizen Vigilante' has sparked controversy after its release, with some countries banning the movie due to its alleged anti-immigrant and violent content. Elon Musk recently shared the film with his followers on X, leading to a backlash against him.
